item: the watchdog-loop tests run on a stepped clock: counts no longer depend on a thread keeping up
summary: test_a_watchdog_tick_that_raises_waits_its_interval_and_does_not_stop_the_looks failed on a loaded CI runner with 1 >= 3 and passed locally: it ran the real loop on a real thread for a fixed 1.7 s and counted calls. The three tests that did that now call the loop on the test thread with a stop that advances a fake clock and a cap on waits; ticks are 0.5, 1.0 and 1.5 s and the looks 67 in 1.8 s, every run. Mutants (the old due placement, the look inside the tick's try) fail by name. Test-only; src/database/writer.py is unchanged.
